_about: The specification graph (ADR-0057, Proposed): the corpus's artifacts as nodes with an open set of layers (§1), typed edges between them, each pinned and each contributing a premise (§3, §4), ADR-0053's derived premises re-expressed over those premises and T-0045-28 as a derived premise of every theorem (§4). Built and checked by spec/specification-graph.py; a record's clauses are pinned by spec/clauses.py (§7). The binding table stays canonical for its row premises.
